semantics.identity_rule: Each reusable capability has explicit identity.
semantics.surface_rule: Operations/types/limits/versions forming the capability are explicit.
semantics.validation_rule: Declaration may require runtime/contract validation before considered available.
semantics.availability_rule: Declared does not mean currently available/healthy.
semantics.authorization_rule: Capability is technical ability only and never AccessCore permission.
semantics.advertisement_rule: External advertisement remains untrusted until mapped/validated.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.
